supporting_context: Kingfisher has launched the first AI-powered assistant in the home improvement sector, harnessing the capability of generative AI to support customers with their DIY projects. Launching initially at Castorama France, the virtual assistant answers customers' DIY queries and provides step-by-step advice on a range of home improvement projects, as well as tailored product recommendations...To power the assistant and support other future applications of AI, Kingfisher's data team has developed a proprietary AI orchestration framework, named Athena. This will manage prompting and interaction with a range of large language models, as well as other AI tools developed in-house.
reviewer_notes: Split out from KGF-REJ-020 (press release mis-routed to rejected as webpage boilerplate) per the anti-overconsolidation check. Named product (Hello Casto, built on Kingfisher's proprietary Athena orchestration framework spanning multiple large language models), explicit generative-AI/LLM language, live deployment at Castorama France, concrete task (DIY query assistance, step-by-step advice, product recommendations) and user group (customers). deployment_stage=live_limited reflects the single-market (Castorama France) initial rollout described in the 2023 press release; quantified_metric=yes reflects the FY2024-25 AR's corroborating figure ('c. 500k interactions with Hello Casto since launch in 2023') confirming continued live status two years on, though that AR passage (KGF-REJ-003/004) bundles Hello Casto with several unrelated non-GenAI initiatives so is not itself promoted -- the quantified corroboration is recorded here in use_case_description instead.
